rationale: Create PearlX as a published U.S. smart-grid and distributed-energy infrastructure platform. Record Antin Infrastructure Partners' majority investment through Antin NextGen Fund I in 2023, and preserve Antin as the active legal owner while recording the publicly disclosed December 2025 full-exit decision as a signed pending exit to an undisclosed counterparty. Add verified legal identity, location, operating profile, ownership, milestones and direct primary citations. Retain Antin's 1Q 2026 report only as research methodology context rather than creating a conflicting company citation to the existing shared source.

afterImage.description: PearlX Infrastructure LLC develops, finances, owns and operates distributed solar, battery-storage and related electrification systems at multifamily properties in the United States. The Charlottesville-based platform installs and maintains the infrastructure without upfront property-owner capital, provides participating residents discounted on-site electricity and pays landlords for use of property space. Founded in 2019, PearlX has operated principally in California and Texas. Antin Infrastructure Partners acquired a majority stake through Antin NextGen Fund I in early 2023. Antin disclosed in March 2026 that it had decided in December 2025 to fully exit the investment; no buyer or completed closing was publicly identified as of August 7, 2026.
